Three-player verification complete: **26/26 checks, zero console errors** across two layers, plus two real gameplay bugs found and fixed first.

**Bugs fixed before testing:**
- All players spawned on the exact same point — stacked inside each other, and in tag mode caused instant zaps at spawn. Spawns now scatter across the pad.
- Players who left stayed on the scoreboard in obby/collect modes (only tag refreshed it). Leave now broadcasts a scoreboard update in every mode.

**Protocol layer (3 simulated players, 13/13):** all three land in the same Zap Tag instance, the third player's join snapshot lists both peers, movement and chat fan out to both peers, the server assigns an "it," a real proximity tag transfers the zap to the touched player (with score credit) while the distant bystander is never tagged, leaving updates everyone's scoreboard, and in Glimmer Rush coin grabs broadcast to peers while a taken coin can't be re-grabbed before respawn.

**Browser layer (3 live Chrome sessions, 13/13):** scoreboards read 3 on every client, peers visibly move in each other's views, chat works in all directions, death + respawn flows correctly, **all three clients hold a steady 24 FPS even on software WebGL sharing one CPU** (a real GPU will be far smoother), three editors co-edit one place simultaneously — each sees the other two presence chips, three concurrent part placements all persist, a third editor's delete syncs live, team chat reaches everyone — and the friends page shows an in-game friend as "Playing Tower of Bother" with a working **Join** button that drops you into their exact server.

Server's still at **http://localhost:3001** — the test accounts (`ace_*`, `bee_*`, `cat_*`) are real users in the database if you want to log in as one alongside your own account and see the multiplayer firsthand.
